candidates.change_summary: Remove the selfdestruct or transfer of the contract balance to owner.
Send the transferred ETH to a different address instead of owner.
Change the call target to a different address.
Insert code to send zero value to target, leaving the contract balance unchanged.
Do not require the external call to succeed, so balance transfer still happens even if target call fails.
Use send instead of transfer, which may silently fail and leave balance in contract.
